summary: Final report OT-20-S0178 for Corvenlea (US): hERG (IKr) safety pharmacology, CYP safety interaction panel on 40 compounds (Aminopyrimidine). Study summary (benchmark) table on page 1; full compound tables, methods and control results follow.

title_block.title: CVL kinase series: cardiac ion-channel and CYP interaction triage
title_block.subtitle: Final Report

blocks.p: 40 compounds from the Corvenlea aminopyrimidine series 01 were tested for Corvenlea (US) in the hERG (IKr) safety pharmacology, CYP safety interaction panel. Testing started on October 6, 2020 and results were reported on October 20, 2020. All runs met control validity criteria. No compound inhibited hERG with an IC50 below 1 µM. Most of the set fell in the 1-10 µM band, so the margin will depend on free therapeutic exposure. Inhibition above 50% at 10 µM was most frequent for CYP2C9.

This exploratory in vitro investigation is not conducted under GLP; procedures follow Osterquill standard operating procedures and the investigation is audited by Quality Assurance for data integrity only.
To rank the test article cohort for hERG (IKr) safety pharmacology, CYP safety interaction panel liability so that Corvenlea (US) could choose analogues for progression.
40 compounds were received as 10 mM DMSO solutions in one test article cohort on October 6, 2020 and logged against OQ/2020/002872. Identity and concentration were taken as supplied by the client.

HEK293 cells stably expressing hERG (KCNH2) were recorded in whole-cell configuration on a 16-channel automated patch clamp platform at room temperature. Cells were held at -80 mV, depolarised to +40 mV for 2 s and repolarised to -50 mV for 2 s to elicit the tail current, at 0.1 Hz. Each compound was applied cumulatively at 0.12, 0.37, 1.1, 3.3, 10 and 30 µM (0.3% DMSO final), with 3-5 minutes per concentration.

list: Control validity: seal resistance ≥500 MΩ before break-in and ≥200 MΩ throughout
Tail current amplitude ≥200 pA at baseline; run-down ≤10% over the vehicle period
Positive control E-4031 on every run; IC50 must fall within 5-50 nM
IC50 from a four-parameter logistic fit of mean tail-current inhibition; n≥2 cells per compound

blocks.p: Pooled human liver microsomes (0.1 mg/mL protein) were incubated with each compound at 10 µM and an isoform-selective probe substrate at approximately Km, in duplicate, for 10 minutes at 37 °C after NADPH addition. Metabolite formation was measured by LC-MS/MS against vehicle (0.1% DMSO) incubations.
Results are reported as mean percent inhibition relative to vehicle. Values above 50% at 10 µM are flagged for follow-up; small negative values indicate no inhibition.

All {{PRJ0012:herg.n_tested}} compounds were tested. No compound inhibited hERG with an IC50 below 1 µM. Most of the set fell in the 1-10 µM band, so the margin will depend on free therapeutic exposure. The median IC50 was {{PRJ0012:herg.median_ic50_uM}} µM ({{PRJ0012:herg.n_lt_1uM}} below 1 µM, {{PRJ0012:herg.n_1_10uM}} between 1 and 10 µM, {{PRJ0012:herg.n_ge_10uM}} at or above 10 µM). E-4031 gave an IC50 of {{PRJ0012:herg.control_e4031_nM}} nM, within the acceptance range.

Inhibition above 50% at 10 µM was most frequent for CYP2C9. In total {{PRJ0012:cyp.n_any_gt50}} compounds inhibited at least one isoform by more than 50% at 10 µM (CYP3A4: {{PRJ0012:cyp.n_gt50_CYP3A4}}; CYP2D6: {{PRJ0012:cyp.n_gt50_CYP2D6}}; CYP2C19: {{PRJ0012:cyp.n_gt50_CYP2C19}}; CYP2C9: {{PRJ0012:cyp.n_gt50_CYP2C9}}; CYP1A2: {{PRJ0012:cyp.n_gt50_CYP1A2}}). Ketoconazole inhibited CYP3A4 with an IC50 of {{PRJ0012:cyp.control_CYP3A4_uM}} µM.

No compound inhibited hERG with an IC50 below 1 µM. Most of the set fell in the 1-10 µM band, so the margin will depend on free therapeutic exposure. Inhibition above 50% at 10 µM was most frequent for CYP2C9. Results are exploratory and are intended for compound selection; they are not a substitute for a definitive GLP safety pharmacology study.
The data support ranking within the set. Recommended next step: select analogues without a hERG or CYP signal for further investigation and repeat any single-run outliers.
